samples.question: The four registers start with the shown ON/OFF states. Read the five XOR cards from left to right. On each card, the two shapes left of the arrow are the source registers: write ON into the shape right of the arrow exactly when the two current source states differ; otherwise write OFF. The other registers stay unchanged. Is the register shown in the QUERY box ON or OFF at the end?
